name: BACH_0188
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Second-model (MUSK) disagrees; 2 of 5 similar cases are Normal.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 99%, Normal 1% | Strongly peaked |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.98 / 76th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Two Normal neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood · Unreliable
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 0, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 3, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Spot check passed 12 of 20 · Weak
- **Neoplastic nuclei, 54% of nuclei** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · Above 90% of reference images; sampled regions only · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Normal and InSitu are confused: MUSK disagrees and two nearest neighbors are Normal.
- Calibration was tested on only 132 images; ECE 5%, interval 3–18%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 5, 6**: confirm atypical cells stay within ducts, with no stromal invasion.
2. **Region 9**: highest regional invasive probability (42%); look for infiltrating stroma.
3. **Regions 7, 10, 11**: verify true two-layered normal lobules; concept spot check failed.
